title: Cohomology of a module sheaf agrees with that of its underlying abelian sheaf
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme with its small Zariski site [def-sc-zariski-site], and let $\mathcal F$ be any sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules. Write $\mathcal F_{\mathrm{ab}}$ for the same sheaf after forgetting the module structure. For every $q\geq0$, the $q$-th right-derived global sections of $\mathcal F$ computed in sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-cohomology] and those of $\mathcal F_{\mathrm{ab}}$ computed in abelian sheaves [def-sc-zariski-cohomology] are canonically isomorphic as abelian groups, naturally in $\mathcal F$.
